title: The 2022 governor result
description: The benchmark every 2027 projection is measured against.
notes: Omar's runner-up total was published two ways: 98,105 (The Star, Capital FM) and 98,108 (The Standard, KNA, NTV). Both are shown; neither is preferred until Form 37C is cited.
Kenyan governor races are won by plurality. 119,083 is a benchmark, not a threshold.
The Mombasa governor election was held on 29 August 2022, three weeks after the general election, after two postponements. Turnout was 34%.
